about: CHK-12 (R-12): the objects SQL manages that the newest Drizzle snapshot does not declare, with the value a database built from the journal gives them and the journal entry after which that value stayed final (found by a fresh build of every journal prefix). An entry may only add a fact the snapshot does not declare; it can never override one. Declared facts that the journal builds differently are pinned by exact key and value in REVIEWED_DRIFT (packages/database/test/journal-schema-parity.support.ts), not here. Values are PostgreSQL renderings; functions and view bodies are md5 of pg_get_functiondef and pg_get_viewdef.
